title: Test groupMaps and pure utils (get-map-region, get-assignment-message)
description: Add missing test files for three pure utility functions that currently have no coverage. groupMaps is central to the map-list display; the other two are simpler but untested.
steps: Write tests for groupMaps: empty array, all singles (no group_code), all same group_code, mixed groups and singles, sorting (multi-map groups before singles)
Write tests for getMapRegion: valid [lat, lng], null input, array shorter than 2
Write tests: happy path with map/user/expiration, empty strings
Run bun test to verify all pass
tests: groupMaps with no group_code: each map becomes its own group keyed by id
groupMaps with shared group_code: maps are merged into one entry
groupMaps sorts multi-map groups before single-map groups
groupMaps handles mixed: some with group_code, some without
acceptanceCriteria: All new tests pass with bun test
